questions.question: Why is a virtual machine or isolated environment recommended for ASM work?
options: It makes scans run faster
It contains tooling and risk, keeping security tools and their data separate from your personal system
It is required by most ASM tool licenses
It hides your identity from scan targets
questions.explanation: An isolated environment keeps your tooling, dependencies, and collected data contained — and limits the blast radius if a tool misbehaves or you make a mistake.

questions.question: Which language toolchain do you need installed to run `go install github.com/owasp-amass/amass/v4/...@master`?
options: Python 3
Node.js
Go
Rust
questions.explanation: Amass, httpx, and gowitness are all Go programs installed with `go install`, which compiles them from source using the Go toolchain.

questions.question: What do API keys for services like Shodan and GitHub add to an ASM setup?
options: They are required before any tool will run
They give access to additional passive data sources and internet-wide scan data
They make active scanning legal against any target
They encrypt your scan results
questions.explanation: API keys unlock richer passive reconnaissance: Shodan provides internet-wide scan data, and the GitHub API enables searching for exposed code and secrets — no active scanning of the target required.

questions.question: What is the best practice for handling API keys in your ASM scripts?
options: Hardcode them in the script so they are never lost
Store them in environment variables or config files excluded from version control
Share them in your team chat for convenience
Commit them to a private GitHub repository
questions.explanation: Keys belong in environment variables or untracked config files. Hardcoding keys in scripts or committing them to repositories is a common source of credential leaks — the very thing ASM hunts for.

questions.question: Which tool from the starter toolkit is installed with pip rather than go install?
options: Amass
httpx
gowitness
Shodan CLI
questions.explanation: The Shodan CLI is a Python package installed with `pip install shodan`. Amass, httpx, and gowitness are Go tools.
